items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 June 2026 5:04am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 13 June 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure north of Scotland, with high pressure south of England gradually tracking northwards.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 at first, decreasing mainly 4 or 5 this afternoon, then veering Northwest this evening. Decreasing 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, becoming Variable 2 to 4 around midday tomorrow, then settling East or Southeast 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
